title: crm.account.products-linked, payload v1
description: cust_acct_prod_invl now links these products to this billing account. Produced by account-service inside the SAME transaction that writes the involvement rows (ADR-013 §8, ADR-017 §8.1). Destination: crm.account.evt.products-linked.v1. This is the SALE's TERMINAL fact: by the time it exists the sale is already real and visible (ADR-016 §5, step 5), which is why ADR-017 §2 approves choreography for reactions to it — a reaction that must not be able to fail the sale is exactly one that should not be a saga step.

accountNumber.description: The KR-11 number — also the envelope's aggregateId. Always a 224 Billing Account; the K-8 223 Customer Account never appears in any API response or event (ADR-013 §4.5).

linkedProductIds.description: Ids linked by THIS command. Empty when every requested id was already linked — the command is idempotent per (account, product), so a legitimate retry by a compensating orchestrator produces an empty delta rather than duplicate rows (ADR-013 §8).

allProductIds.description: The account's FULL involvement set after the command — the same list the synchronous response returns. Published alongside the delta so a consumer that wants state rather than a change needs no back-call into account-service.
